candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: order's POST payment call to payment /v1/authorizations times out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), propagating a 502 up through order to gateway /v1/checkout. Inventory/redis calls succeed quickly, isolating the delay to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs absent; whether payment is slow or unreachable vs. a client timeout misconfiguration is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing with a payment ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway /v1/checkout p95 is ~2406ms with 502s. Topology confirms order->payment. Bounded candidate: downstream latency at payment. Payment-side telemetry and logs are missing to fully confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Gateway/order logs (ev-...-gw_logs excluded) to confirm timeout origin
